# Security policy

silentVIP takes the security of its products and of the travelers who rely on them seriously.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not open a public issue** for a security problem.

- Email **support@silentvip.com** with the subject "Security", or follow the disclosure policy at https://www.silentvip.com/trust#disclosure.
- Machine-readable contact: https://www.silentvip.com/.well-known/security.txt

Include what you found, where (product, URL or app version), how to reproduce it and the impact you expect. We will acknowledge your report, keep you informed while we fix it, and credit you if you wish.

## Scope

All repositories in the [silentvip-com](https://github.com/silentvip-com) organization and the services they run, including www.silentvip.com, silentvip.org, mcp.silentvip.com and the silentVIP mobile apps.
